name: Resident biometric templates (fingerprint; iris; face) in the ID Repository
rationale: Biometric traits are permanent so confidentiality must outlast the resident (capped at 50y; the CRQC model is extrapolated). Repository sits inside the national data centre; hardened so classical hazard is the lowest band. At-rest encryption documented [VERIFY]. Transit protection assumed RSA-based [VERIFY].

name: Resident demographic data and UIN mapping
rationale: Identity attributes are lifelong. UINs are hashed and encrypted at rest per the docs [VERIFY].

name: Registration packets sent from enrolment centres to the server
rationale: Offline-first client uploads encrypted packets (demographics + biometrics) over the network from remote centres. Packet encryption assumed RSA-2048 key wrapping [VERIFY]. FLOW ASSET: V is one year of packets, turnover 1. Consistency rule: V_flow ~ turnover_store x V_store = 0.05 x $10M = $0.5M, rounded up to the HIGH band ($1M).

name: Authentication and e-KYC exchanges with partner organisations (banks; telcos)
rationale: Partners subscribe to policies; TLS plus application-layer encryption with signed partner certificates per the docs [VERIFY]. e-KYC responses carry lifelong demographic attributes.

name: Operator and partner session tokens and one-time codes
rationale: Minutes-to-hours lifetime. Control case: the quantum leg must vanish.

name: Authentication and registration audit logs (contain identifiers)
Disaster-recovery copies of the ID Repository
rationale: Copies replicated to a secondary site over partly exposed paths; same lifetime as the primary.

name: Internal service-to-service traffic inside the national data centre
rationale: MOSIP is deployed inside the country's data centres with no biometric data leaving national borders per the docs [VERIFY]; collection would require an insider or in-network position. FLOW ASSET: V is one year of internal traffic (turnover 1), consistent with the repository-stock rule (about 5% of the $10M stock per year, rounded to the HIGH band).

name: Published schemas; UI labels and configuration
evidence_for_zeroing: Documentation and schemas are published openly in the MOSIP repositories and docs site; no confidentiality requirement.
rationale: Control case: both legs must vanish.
